snippet.title: Once Upon a Jester - PS5 & XBSX|S Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step right up! 🎪
Jester and his best friend Sok are bringing their whimsical improv adventure to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on October 24th!

Once Upon a Jester is a heartwarming comedy about friendship, creativity, and the joy of making people laugh. Travel the kingdom performing improvised shows, meet quirky townsfolk, and sing your hearts out!

🎭 Coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on October 24th!
